title: A dungeon crawler
hints: Keep the map's letters out of the grid: when loading, record the player, enemies, coins and exit in their own variables, and leave floor in their place.
For the enemies' turn, compute one BFS from the player and let every enemy read it; check `enemyAt` before stepping so two enemies never share a cell.
requirements: Walls block, enemies are attacked by walking into them, and coins are collected by walking onto them.
The exit only wins with every coin collected, and the game ends at 0 hit points.
Enemies within 8 steps chase along shortest paths without stacking on each other, and attack when adjacent.
The travel path is the cheapest one through swamp.
stretch: Add field of view (only draw cells the player can see, with remembered cells dimmed), keys and locked doors, and enemies that flee when they are down to 1 hit point.
